style: rough graphite storyboard sketch, loose gestural linework, minimal cross-hatching, grey marker wash, black and white, no color, unfinished edges, production board not illustration
negative: color, painterly rendering, photorealistic, 3d render, clean vector lines, text, watermark, signature, logo, borders, frame

characters.sable: mechanic, late 20s, short dark hair, heavy canvas work jacket, forearms bare
characters.roon: younger, hair tied back, pale collarless shirt, no jacket

shots.label: cont'd
shots.caption: ...CAMERA now over Sable on Roon... she stops...
shots.camera: over-the-shoulder, 40mm, camera at bench height, Sable's head and shoulder a dark out-of-focus mass occupying frame left foreground, Roon standing small in deep background right, framed in a lit doorway, full figure
shots.action: Roon has stopped walking. Weight still forward. She has just seen it.

shots.label: SHOT 10
shots.caption: CLOSE on Roon: "What is that... What's going on here?!"
shots.camera: close-up, 85mm, camera slightly below eyeline, head fills frame, subject centered, eyeline just off lens to camera left, shallow background falloff
shots.action: Reaction. Mouth parting, brows up and drawn in. Not yet angry — still resolving what she is looking at.

shots.label: SHOT 11
shots.caption: SABLE: "Uhh.. Oh, c'mon...let's face it, you've caught me doing worse things..."
shots.camera: low angle, 24mm wide, camera near floor looking up, verticals converging hard, subject centered, a horizontal gantry rig crossing the top third of frame
shots.action: Sable pinned under the rig, both arms up holding it off her chest. Talking her way out of it from flat on her back.

shots.label: SHOT 12
shots.caption: WIDE — neither of them moves. Hold on it.
shots.camera: wide two-shot, 35mm, camera at standing eye height, both figures full-length and separated across frame, heavy machine bulk frame right, deep floor perspective
shots.action: A beat. The distance between them is the shot.

shots.label: SHOT 13
shots.caption: INSERT — her hands, still on the coupling. She hasn't let go.
shots.camera: insert close-up, 100mm macro, camera looking down at a shallow angle, cylindrical coupling running across frame, two hands gripping it, no faces in frame
shots.action: She is still holding the thing she is denying.
